title: Grimoire content pack metadata
description: The _meta.json of a content pack — the catalog content (spells, classes, feats) a character sheet draws from. Installed server-wide by an admin, then imported into a ruleset per table.

pack_id.description: Unique id, matching the directory name.

schema_id.description: The character sheet this pack supplies content for. Not a hard reference — a pack may be installed before the sheet is.

attribution.description: Credit shown verbatim wherever this pack's content appears. Required when 'license' is set.

source.description: Short label each entry is tagged with, so 'Fireball (srd)' is distinguishable from a table's own.
